## What's Changed
* Update golangci-lint by @mtibben in https://github.com/99designs/aws-vault/pull/1194
* Fix credential type detection for login by @mtibben in https://github.com/99designs/aws-vault/pull/1193
* Prioritise `source_profile` over sso config by @mtibben in https://github.com/99designs/aws-vault/pull/1196
* Fix ini output to match credentials file by @mtibben in https://github.com/99designs/aws-vault/commit/a4f5e3dc3fd2dbe61a1527adbe945374d8973b94

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/99designs/aws-vault/compare/v7.1.2...v7.2.0
